# Feature: Guard — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #37 (Guard) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: blocks a corridor, turns every 4 moves. Unique: never moves, its facing cycles on a move count. Useful: a timed window through one corridor tile. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** blocks a corridor, turns every 4 moves.

**So that** a timed window through one corridor tile.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Guard for the first time in its teaching room (mech-37-guard-room). Teaching moment: First room: a guard faces you at the end of its corridor when you arrive. A player who walks straight in meets it from the front and is reset, so the retry teaches that its facing cycle, shown by its arrow, creates the window rather than its position. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It never leaves its corridor tile and rotates its facing 90 degrees every four player moves, shown by an arrow
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping onto its tile from the front it faces resets you
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Entering from behind, while its back is turned, you pass

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It never leaves its corridor tile and rotates its facing 90 degrees every four player moves, shown by an arrow
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Guard's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-37-guard-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #37.
